## What this changes, and why

## Checklist

- [ ] No Capture One files, and nothing taken from decompiled or disassembled Capture One code ([ground rules](https://github.com/ProtonCats/Project-Halation-For-Capture-One/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ground-rules-for-every-contribution))
- [ ] Sign-in, activation and the install folder stay untouched
- [ ] A Wine fix comes with a program in `repro/` that shows the bug on its own
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, the Developer Certificate of Origin)
